state.title: State without the boilerplate
state.description: NgRx SignalStore replaces actions, reducers and effects with a single declarative store. No services holding private signals, no subscriptions to clean up.
points: Stores provided in root and injected straight into components
Computed values derive automatically, with no manual wiring
patchState keeps updates type-safe end to end
Zoneless change detection: Angular reacts to signals, not to zone patching

auth.title: Tokens your JavaScript can't read
auth.description: Most templates store the JWT in localStorage, which means any injected script can walk off with the session. Here the token never reaches JavaScript.

storage.localStorage: In the browser store, readable by any script
storage.httpOnly: In a cookie the browser refuses to expose to JavaScript

xss.localStorage: The session is stolen in a single line
xss.httpOnly: The script cannot read the cookie

csrf.localStorage: Not needed, but the token is exposed

refresh.httpOnly: The cookie travels on its own, session validated on init

setup.localStorage: Return the token in the response body
